one_liner: Developers can launch internal integrations instantly. Public integrations require Notion review and approval before other workspaces can connect, with an unknown wait time.

start_today.summary: Developers can create and use 'internal integrations' immediately within their own Notion workspace. These do not require Notion review or approval.
limits_before_approval: Public integrations cannot be used by other Notion workspaces until they have been submitted for review and approved by Notion.
The Authorization URL for a public connection is not available until after it has been submitted for review.

Notion API rate limits are tiered: 180 requests per minute per connection for Free and Plus plans, and 600 requests per minute per connection for Business and Enterprise plans. It is uncertain if these limits apply to unreviewed public integrations.

composio.note: Composio provides a managed OAuth app for Notion, allowing developers to launch immediately. A custom app is needed for custom branding on the consent screen, extra scopes, dedicated rate limits, faster trigger polling, or self-hosted instances.

prerequisites.detail: A standard Notion account is required to create an integration.
The user creating the integration must be a Workspace owner to access the 'Connections' tab and create integrations.

steps.text: Visit the Notion Developer portal's 'My integrations' page.
Provide a Connection name and Icon, specify a development workspace, and enter Redirect URI(s).
Enter your Company name, Website, Privacy policy URL, and Terms of service URL.
Retrieve your OAuth Client ID and Client Secret from the Configuration tab after creation.
Implement the Authorization Code Grant flow, including Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) parameters.
Handle short-lived access tokens (1 hour expiry) and long-lived refresh tokens (1 year expiry).
Implement refresh token rotation, where each successful refresh returns a new access token and a new refresh token, invalidating the previous refresh token.
Submit the public integration for Notion's review.
Wait for Notion's approval before other workspaces can connect to your integration.
Note that the Authorization URL field will populate only after the public connection is submitted for review.

steps.text: Instruct users to manually share specific pages or databases with your connection to grant API permissions, as Notion's API permissions are primarily managed this way rather than explicit OAuth scopes.

steps.text: Monitor and adhere to Notion's API rate limits, which include a per-connection limit and a separate per-workspace limit, with some endpoints having specific limits.

approval.trigger: Submission of a public integration for review. The Authorization URL becomes available after this submission.
reviewers_check: Connection name and Icon (what users see on the consent screen)

blockers.blocker: Public integrations cannot be used by other workspaces until approved by Notion.
blockers.fix: Submit the integration for review and await Notion's approval.

blockers.blocker: The Authorization URL is not available until after the public connection is submitted for review.
blockers.fix: Complete the integration setup and submit it for review to obtain the Authorization URL.

blockers.blocker: Redirect URIs must use HTTPS, except for loopback hosts (http://localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1]) for local development. Any other redirect URI must exactly match the one provided in the authorization request.
blockers.fix: Ensure all production redirect URIs use HTTPS and match exactly. Use loopback hosts only for local development.

agent_can: Draft the app description (Connection name and Icon) based on the agent's purpose.
Check redirect URI settings for compliance with Notion's requirements.
Run a test OAuth flow once credentials are obtained.
Prepare answers for review questions related to connection capabilities.
you_must: Be a Notion Workspace owner to create integrations.
Provide legal attestations such as Company name, Website, Privacy policy URL, and Terms of service URL.
Manually submit the public integration for Notion's review.
Manually share Notion pages or databases with the connection to grant API permissions.
provider_controls: Generation of Client ID and Client Secret.
Availability of the Authorization URL (after submission for review).
Security review process for public OAuth apps.
